content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PD alert fired (PD-9923): repeated cuda_alloc_failed / GPU OOMs in pool `inference-west2a`. ~40% of nodes reporting alloc failures. https://pdt.example/PD-9923

jordan: Acked and joining. Pulling node-level logs and pod statuses now. @carol can you take handoff after triage?

pd-bot: PagerDuty: alert acknowledged by jordan. Escalation to SRE Lead in 10m if not reassigned.

jordan: Quick cluster view:
```
kubectl get pods -n rl-inference -o wide | egrep "inference|embed"
inference-rc1-5  0/1 CrashLoopBackOff  gpu-node-09  10.2.4.9
embed-svc-11    1/1 Running         gpu-node-03  10.2.4.3
```
`nvidia-smi` on gpu-node-09 shows high reserved pages and memory fragmentation. Kubelet logs contain repeated "cuda: alloc failed" and kernel messages showing nvkm_gpu allocation failures.

michelle: Customer impact: Enterprise customer QueryStream seeing 502/503 on embeddings and higher tail latency. Ticket INC-1288 opened; AMs notified.

carol: Plan proposal: 1) Immediately cordon worst nodes and drain non-critical pods. 2) Redirect a slice of inference traffic to `inference-west2b` warm pool. 3) Trigger temporary autoscale +3 for west2a and reduce embeddings max_batch for 20m. If fragmentation remains, schedule rolling host reboots and driver rebind on canary.

alex: I'll run the reroute and scale commands now:
```
redwoodctl pools scale inference-west2a --add 3 --note "hot OOM mitigation"
redwoodctl traffic redirect --from inference-west2a --to inference-west2b --pct 30
```
Executing.

pd-bot: Action recorded: traffic redirect 30% scheduled; scale request submitted.

jordan: Cordoned gpu-node-09 and draining batch jobs. Evicting low-priority pods first:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-09
kubectl drain gpu-node-09 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
Evictions in progress ~55%.

michelle: After reroute error rate on embeddings dropped from 15% -> 6%. Customer notified with status update.

carol: Good. Monitoring kernel allocation failure counts and kvcache eviction rate. If the noisy host shows continued OOMs after drain, we'll reboot and run driver reload loop on that host.

jordan: Posting relevant log excerpts (trimmed):
```
[23456.123456] nvkm: failed to allocate 0x8000000: -12
[23456.123789] cuda: alloc failed: out of memory
[23456.456000] pod "inference-rc1-5" OOMKilled: cuda alloc failure
```
Also seeing CUBLAS allocation errors inside containers and high fragmentation metric on host.

alex: Auto-scale completed (+3). Traffic reroute applied. Monitoring pool health.

incident-bot: Automated mitigation applied: 30% traffic shift to inference-west2b; inference-west2a scaled +3. PD incident updated.

michelle: Customer INC-1288 updated. No immediate request to escalate. Will keep AM loop informed.

carol: Next steps: 1) Keep 1h watch, 2) If alloc failures resurface, run kernel+driver canary on gpu-node-15, 3) Add runbook action: add kvcache fragmentation alert threshold and auto-evacuation rule. jordan, attach node logs to PD incident and open a follow-up doc.

jordan: Logs attached to PD-9923 and to internal incident doc. Filing follow-up: reduce embeddings max_batch under high-gpu-pressure as temporary mitigation.

alex: Filing PR for auto-throttle config and runbook updates.

carol: Closing PD for now as mitigated; we'll stay on watch for 60m. If embeddings error rate rises above 7% re-open and escalate.

pd-bot: PD-9923 state changed -> mitigated (monitoring). Notes and logs uploaded.

michelle: Thanks all. I'll ping if QueryStream reports regression. :white_check_mark:
